name: DPDK vhost VM-to-VM local unicast delivery; split virtqueue, ordinary no-offload case
selected_subpath: Guest A TX producer → backend local MAC routing (--vm2vm=1) → guest B posted RX buffer → used publication → B guest PMD frame delivery; reciprocal traffic supplies a possible natural peer.
selection_progression: One vhost source was selected. Within that source, direct-NIC-RX-to-guest weakens the staged ingress necessity argument, so the final frozen task uses the real VM2VM software branch. No second workflow was added.
new_fact: Receiver posts the address/length of its own mbuf and later resolves used ID back to the same cookie. Useful output is delivery of complete Ethernet frame to that receiver buffer, not a benchmark copy count.
GPU_AI_priority: Retained as preference. A lightweight FSDP search was navigation only, not a frozen candidate or evidence of its infeasibility. This round selects a directly sourced memory-to-memory delivery task without inventing an AI runtime/consumer; closed AI cards stay closed.
online_docs_note: Public guides-25.11 currently display 25.11.3; all decisive source claims use exact v25.11 commit files. OASIS 1.3 page was navigation only and is not a claimed final standard/evidence dependency.
metadata_provenance: Tag, annotated tag, commit and full tree receipts copied unchanged from stage117-r2 same-release provenance; new vhost files fetched independently and blob-checked against that tree.
